conventions.plane: ℝ × ℝ with Mathlib's max norm (balls are squares)
conventions.integral: ∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k (Lebesgue measure). Outside a statement, where Ψ k does not fix the type, write the cast as ((m * (Ψ k + L k) : ℝ) : ℂ), else elaboration fails with HMul ℝ ℝ ℂ. The D4 front ends (FE-S4.1′, FE-S4.1′L) use t * φ κ + L κ with L NOT scaled by t (uniform over all L).
conventions.linear_terms: L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ; a vector x is x.1 • fst + x.2 • snd
conventions.amplitudes: amplitude A : ℝ×ℝ → ℂ of class C² with tsupport A ⊆ K and ‖D^j A‖ ≤ M for j ≤ 2 (F1 gives M for any compactly supported Cⁿ A)
conventions.smooth: write ∞ (open scoped ContDiff) for C^∞; ContDiff ℝ ⊤ means analytic in this Mathlib
conventions.status: docs/STATUS.md is authoritative; this index does not state statuses
conventions.gradient_norm: ‖fderiv ℝ Ψ k + L‖ is the operator norm of a functional on ℝ × ℝ with the max norm, i.e. |a| + |b| for (a, b) ↦ a x + b y
conventions.smoothness_cast: C^{N+1} is ContDiff ℝ (↑N + 1) with N : ℕ; a numeral N may need ((3 : ℕ) + 1) to unify
conventions.hessian: OscInt.Statements.hessianMatrix Ψ k = Matrix.of fun i j => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 Ψ k ![coordVec i, coordVec j], coordVec = ![(1,0),(0,1)]; nondegenerate means (hessianMatrix Ψ k).det ≠ 0
conventions.discriminant: disc / discr is Mathlib's Cubic.discr of a X³ + b X² + c X + d (C5), the discriminant of the binary cubic a x³ + b x²y + c xy² + d y³; discr < 0 hyperbolic, > 0 elliptic umbilic
conventions.multilinear_arguments: Statements apply D³φ(0) to ![(x, y), (x, y), (x, y)]; the Poly helpers produce (fun _ => v); convert with funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
conventions.rpow: t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3) is Real.rpow; m ≥ 1 throughout
conventions.lean_statement: each entry's lean_statement is the frozen definition, verbatim from its statement file; the proving theorem has exactly this type

statements.label: S1.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.VdC1Statement
statements.summary: First-derivative van der Corput bound with amplitude, constant 3.
statements.lean_statement:
def VdC1Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b ν : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < ν →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b →
    (MonotoneOn φ' (Ioo a b) ∨ AntitoneOn φ' (Ioo a b)) →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, ν ≤ |φ' x|) →
    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt φ ψ a b‖ ≤ 3 / ν * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b
hypotheses: φ, φ′ with derivatives on [a, b] (continuous up to the endpoints)

statements.label: S1.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.VdC2Statement
statements.summary: Second-derivative van der Corput bound with amplitude, constant 8, uniform in a linear term.
statements.lean_statement:
def VdC2Statement : Prop :=
  ∀ (φ φ' φ'' : ℝ → ℝ) (ψ ψ' : ℝ → ℂ) (a b μ p : ℝ), a ≤ b → 0 < μ →
    HasDerivOn φ φ' a b → HasDerivOn φ' φ'' a b →
    (∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, μ ≤ |φ'' x|) →
    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →
    ‖oscInt (fun x => φ x + p * x) ψ a b‖ ≤ 8 / √μ * ampNorm ψ ψ' a b

    AmplitudeOn ψ ψ' a b →

statements.label: S2.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.NonStationaryStatement
statements.summary: Non-stationary phase: decay `m^{-N}`, uniform over a compact family and over every linear term with `|∇(Ψ_σ + p·)| ≥ c` on `K`.
statements.lean_statement:
def NonStationaryStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Λ : Type) [TopologicalSpace Λ] [CompactSpace Λ] (N : ℕ) (Ψ : Λ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (c : ℝ),
    FamilyCk (N + 1) Ψ → IsCompact K → 0 < c →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (σ : Λ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound N K A M → (∀ k ∈ K, GradLower (Ψ σ) p k c) → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ σ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M / m ^ N
statements.conclusion: |oscInt2(m(Ψ_σ + p·), A)| ≤ C M m^{-N} for AmpBound N K A M
statements.uniform_over: σ, p with the gradient bound, A, M

statements.label: S2.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.StationaryPhaseStatement
statements.summary: Nondegenerate stationary phase: decay `m^{-1}`, uniform over `p ∈ K'`.
statements.lean_statement:
def StationaryPhaseStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K K' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
    ContDiff ℝ 4 Ψ → IsCompact K → IsCompact K' →
    (∀ p ∈ K', ∀ k ∈ K, IsCritical Ψ p k → hessDet Ψ k ≠ 0) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 K A M → p ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M / m
hypotheses: Hessian nondegenerate at every critical point of Ψ + p· in K, p ∈ K′
statements.conclusion: bound C M m^{-1}

statements.label: S3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldStatement
statements.summary: Uniform fold estimate: decay `m^{-5/6}`, uniform over a compact family and over `p ∈ K'`.
statements.lean_statement:
def FoldStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Λ : Type) [TopologicalSpace Λ] [CompactSpace Λ] (Ψ : Λ → ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K K' : Set (ℝ × ℝ)),
    FamilyCk 4 Ψ → IsCompact K → IsCompact K' →
    (∀ σ, ∀ k ∈ K, FoldOrNondeg (Ψ σ) k) →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (σ : Λ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 K A M → p ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖oscInt2 (fun k => m * (Ψ σ k + lin p k)) A‖ ≤ C * M * m ^ (-(5 : ℝ) / 6)
hypotheses: fold-or-nondegenerate at every point of K
statements.conclusion: bound C M m^{-5/6}

statements.label: S4.1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4BoundStatement
statements.summary: Uniform D4 estimate: at a point with vanishing Hessian whose cubic part has negative discriminant, `|∫ e^{i(tφ(κ) + y·κ)} A(κ) dκ| ≤ C M t^{-2/3}` for amplitudes supported near `0`, uniformly in `y ∈ ℝ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4BoundStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) → disc (cubicCoeffs φ) < 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall 0 δ) A M → 1 ≤ t →
        ‖oscInt2 (fun κ => t * φ κ + lin y κ) A‖ ≤ C * M * t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: ∃ δ, C: |oscInt2(tφ + y·, A)| ≤ C M t^{-2/3} for A supported in B̄(0, δ)
statements.uniform_over: all linear terms y, A, M

statements.label: S4.1′
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4BoundNeStatement
statements.summary: Uniform D4 estimate at both umbilics: as `D4BoundStatement` with `disc ≠ 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4BoundNeStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) → disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (y : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ),

statements.label: S4.2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4LimitStatement
statements.summary: D4 limit: `t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → c_C A(0)`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4LimitStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → φ 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ 0 = 0 → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) →
    disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), AmpBound 2 (Metric.closedBall 0 δ) A M →
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) : ℝ) : ℂ) * oscInt2 (fun κ => t * φ κ) A) atTop
        (𝓝 ((d4Constant (cubicCoeffs φ) : ℂ) * A 0))
statements.conclusion: t^{2/3} oscInt2(tφ, A) → c_C A(0) for A supported in B̄(0, δ)

statements.label: S4.3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4ConstantPosStatement
statements.summary: The constant is positive: the improper integral converges to a positive number, and for `disc ≠ 0` the angular integrand is integrable and `c_C > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4ConstantPosStatement : Prop :=
  Tendsto cosMomentPartial atTop (𝓝 cosMoment) ∧ 0 < cosMoment ∧
    ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, disc q ≠ 0 →
      IntervalIntegrable (fun θ => |cubicForm q (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ)| ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧ 0 < d4Constant q
statements.conclusion: c_C(q) > 0 (and the defining improper integral converges)

statements.label: S4.4
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4ConstantClosedFormStatement
statements.summary: Closed forms: `∫₀^∞ cos u · u^{-1/3} du = Γ(2/3)/2`; `c_C = Γ(1/3)²/(√3 |Disc|^{1/6})` for `Disc < 0` and `c_C = Γ(1/3)²/Disc^{1/6}` for `Disc > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4ConstantClosedFormStatement : Prop :=
  cosMoment = Real.Gamma (2 / 3) / 2 ∧
    (∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, disc q < 0 →
      d4Constant q = Real.Gamma (1 / 3) ^ 2 / (Real.sqrt 3 * |disc q| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6))) ∧
    ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, 0 < disc q → d4Constant q = Real.Gamma (1 / 3) ^ 2 / disc q ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)

statements.label: F1
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.AmpBoundOfContDiffStatement
statements.summary: Amplitude bounds from Mathlib's idiom: a `Cⁿ` amplitude with `tsupport A ⊆ K`, `K` compact, satisfies `AmpBound n K A M` for some `M`.
hypotheses: A of class Cⁿ with tsupport A ⊆ K
statements.conclusion: ∃ M, AmpBound n K A M

statements.label: F2
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.D4LimitClosedFormStatement
statements.summary: The D4 limit with its closed-form constant (the brief's S4), for a `C²` amplitude supported near `0`: `t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → Γ(1/3)²/(√3 |Disc|^{1/6}) A(0)` if `Disc < 0`, and `→ Γ(1/3)²/Disc^{1/6} A(0)` if `Disc > 0`.
statements.lean_statement:
def D4LimitClosedFormStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 4 φ → φ 0 = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ 0 = 0 → (∀ v w, dd φ 0 v w = 0) →
    disc (cubicCoeffs φ) ≠ 0 →
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ 2 A → tsupport A ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 δ →
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ((t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          ∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(t * φ k) * Complex.I) * A k) atTop
        (𝓝 ((d4ClosedConstant (disc (cubicCoeffs φ)) : ℂ) * A 0))
hypotheses: A of class C² supported in B̄(0, δ)
statements.conclusion: t^{2/3} ∫ e^{itφ} A → d4ClosedConstant(disc) A(0)

statements.label: C7
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldOrNondegIffStatement
statements.summary: `FoldOrNondeg` in matrix form (span form and rank form) for `Ψ` of class `C³` near `k`.

def FoldOrNondegIffStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 3 Ψ k →
    (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔ FoldOrNondegMatrix Ψ k) ∧
      (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔
        FoldCondRank (hessianMatrix Ψ k) (fun e => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 Ψ k ![ofFin2 e, ofFin2 e, ofFin2 e]))

statements.label: C7′
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldOrNondegOfHasFDerivStatement
statements.summary: `FoldOrNondeg` from derivative data: `Ψ' = D₁`, `D₁' = D₂` everywhere and `D₂'(k) = D₃`.
statements.lean_statement:
def FoldOrNondegOfHasFDerivStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (D₁ : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D₂ : ℝ × ℝ → (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (D₃ : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (k : ℝ × ℝ),
    (∀ y, HasFDerivAt Ψ (D₁ y) y) → (∀ y, HasFDerivAt D₁ (D₂ y) y) → HasFDerivAt D₂ D₃ k →
    (FoldOrNondeg Ψ k ↔
      FoldCondSpan (Matrix.of fun i j => D₂ k (coordVec i) (coordVec j))
        (fun e => D₃ (ofFin2 e) (ofFin2 e) (ofFin2 e)))
statements.conclusion: FoldOrNondeg from HasFDerivAt data D₁, D₂, D₃

statements.label: C8
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.GradLowerIffStatement
statements.summary: `GradLower` as a norm bound: Euclidean (an equivalence) and max norm (both directions, losing `√2`).
statements.lean_statement:
def GradLowerIffStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p k : ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ k → 0 ≤ c →
    (GradLower Ψ p k c ↔
        c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => Ψ (x 0, x 1) + lin p (x 0, x 1)) (toEuclid k)‖) ∧
      (GradLower Ψ p k c → c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => Ψ x + lin p x) k‖) ∧
      (c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => Ψ x + lin p x) k‖ → GradLower Ψ p k (c / Real.sqrt 2))
statements.conclusion: GradLower ↔ Euclidean gradient bound; max-norm bounds losing √2

statements.label: C9
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.AmpBoundConvStatement
statements.summary: `AmpBound` and Mathlib's idiom: (i) on a compact `K` it gives `Cⁿ` with compact support; (ii) `Cⁿ` with compact support gives `AmpBound n (tsupport A) A M` for some `M`.
statements.lean_statement:
def AmpBoundConvStatement : Prop :=
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), IsCompact K → AmpBound n K A M →
      ContDiff ℝ n A ∧ HasCompactSupport A) ∧
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ), ContDiff ℝ n A → HasCompactSupport A → ∃ M : ℝ, AmpBound n (tsupport A) A M
statements.conclusion: AmpBound ↔ ContDiff with compact support

statements.name: OscInt.Statements.NonStationaryFEStatement
statements.summary: Non-stationary phase in Mathlib's idiom (one phase): decay `m^{-N}`, uniform over amplitudes with derivative bound `M` and over linear terms `L` with `‖DΨ(k) + L‖ ≥ c` on `K`.
statements.lean_statement:
def NonStationaryFEStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (N : ℕ) (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (N + 1) Ψ → IsCompact K → 0 < c →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ N A → tsupport A ⊆ K → (∀ j ≤ N, ∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A k‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ k ∈ K, c ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Ψ k + L‖) → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k‖ ≤ C * M / m ^ N
statements.conclusion: |∫ e^{im(Ψ+L)} A| ≤ C M m^{-N} for amplitudes (N, K, M)
statements.uniform_over: L with the gradient bound, A, M

statements.label: FE-S2.2

def StationaryPhaseFEStatement : Prop :=

    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (A : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (M : ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 A → tsupport A ⊆ K → (∀ j ≤ 2, ∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A k‖ ≤ M) → L ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) * A k‖ ≤ C * M / m
hypotheses: Hessian matrix invertible at critical points of Ψ + L, L ∈ K′
statements.conclusion: bound C M m^{-1}

statements.label: FE-S3
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.FoldFEStatement
statements.summary: Uniform fold estimate in Mathlib's idiom (one phase): decay `m^{-5/6}`, uniform over `L ∈ K'`.

statements.summary: Dispersive decay of the 2D lattice Laplacian: `|K(t, x)| ≤ C t^{-2/3}` for `t ≥ 1`, uniformly over `x ∈ ℤ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def LatticeLaplacianDecayStatement : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ × ℤ), 1 ≤ t → ‖latticeKernel t x‖ ≤ C * t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: |∫_{[−π,π]²} e^{i(t(cos k₁ + cos k₂) + x·k)} dk| ≤ C t^{-2/3} for t ≥ 1

statements.label: T0E
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.LatticeKernel1ExplicitStatement
statements.summary: Explicit bound for the 1D lattice kernel: `|I(t, ξ)| ≤ 24 · 2^{1/4} t^{−1/2} + 36 · 2^{1/6} t^{−1/3}` for every `t > 0` and every real `ξ`.
statements.lean_statement:
def LatticeKernel1ExplicitStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ t ξ : ℝ, 0 < t →
    ‖latticeKernel1 t ξ‖ ≤
      24 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) * t ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) + 36 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6) * t ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: |∫_{−π}^{π} e^{i(t cos k + ξk)} dk| ≤ 24·2^{1/4} t^{-1/2} + 36·2^{1/6} t^{-1/3} (beats the trivial bound 2π only for t > 518)

statements.label: T6F
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.LatticeKernelFactorStatement
statements.summary: The 2D lattice kernel factorises: `K(t, x) = I(t, x₁) I(t, x₂)` for every real `t` and `x ∈ ℤ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def LatticeKernelFactorStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ × ℤ), latticeKernel t x = latticeKernel1 t (x.1 : ℝ) * latticeKernel1 t (x.2 : ℝ)
statements.conclusion: latticeKernel t x = latticeKernel1 t x₁ · latticeKernel1 t x₂ (the 2D kernel is a product of 1D kernels)

statements.label: T6E
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.LatticeLaplacianExplicitStatement
statements.summary: Dispersive decay of the 2D lattice Laplacian with an explicit constant: `|K(t, x)| ≤ (24 · 2^{1/4} + 36 · 2^{1/6})² t^{−2/3}` for `t ≥ 1`, uniformly over `x ∈ ℤ²`.
statements.lean_statement:
def LatticeLaplacianExplicitStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : ℤ × ℤ), 1 ≤ t →
    ‖latticeKernel t x‖ ≤
      (24 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 4) + 36 * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 6)) ^ 2 * t ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
statements.conclusion: |∫_{[−π,π]²} e^{i(t(cos k₁ + cos k₂) + x·k)} dk| ≤ (24·2^{1/4} + 36·2^{1/6})² t^{-2/3} (constant < 4761; beats the trivial bound 4π² only for t > 1321, docs/statements.md Batch LE, clarification 6)

statements.label: GD-C-V
statements.name: OscInt.Statements.GlobalDecayCritVecStatement
statements.summary: GD-C for amplitudes with values in any complex Banach space `E` (`E : Type`), with a constant independent of `E`.
statements.lean_statement:
def GlobalDecayCritVecStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (K U : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (K' : Set ((ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (D : Finset (ℝ × ℝ)),
    IsCompact K → IsOpen U → K ⊆ U → (↑D : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ⊆ U → IsCompact K' → ContDiffOn ℝ 4 Ψ U →
    ClassifiedCrit Ψ K K' D →
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E]
      (A : ℝ × ℝ → E) (M : ℝ) (L : (ℝ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 A → tsupport A ⊆ K → (∀ j ≤ 2, ∀ k, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A k‖ ≤ M) → L ∈ K' → 1 ≤ m →
      ‖∫ k : ℝ × ℝ, Complex.exp (↑(m * (Ψ k + L k)) * Complex.I) • A k‖ ≤ C * M * m ^ (-(2 : ℝ) / 3)
hypotheses: Ψ C⁴ on open U ⊇ K, K compact, K′ compact
D a Finset ⊆ U of D4 points (IsD4Point)
FoldOrNondegMatrix at every critical point of Ψ + L in K \ D, L ∈ K′ (ClassifiedCrit)
E any complex Banach space (E : Type); amplitude A : ℝ² → E
statements.conclusion: as GD-C with ‖∫ e^{im(Ψ+L)} • A‖ in E; one constant C for every E
